messages:
alex: Morning async — quick standup for SRE. Drop 1) what you did yesterday 2) blockers 3) today. Call out any oncall followups. Looping in @mike on the KV-evict canary. :wave:

sre-bot: Alert summary: eu-west 5xx spike between 00:45-01:10 UTC (auto-grouped). See incident INC-2345.

mike: Yesterday: ramped canary for kv-evict; observed tail latency bump (~8% p99) during the window. Looked at GC and host metrics, GC looks normal. Blocker: can't repro locally with load. Today: rolled canary back to 10% and added extra logging. Paging @taylor for batching/throttle review. :eyes:

taylor: Ack. Quick check: suspect batcher backlog -> ran a log query and saw queue growth matching the spike window. Posting snippet.

taylor: ```bash
dune logs --service batcher --since 3h | grep -E "queue_length|backlog"
# saw repeated 'queue_length=1024' on two hosts during 00:47-01:00 UTC
```

linh: Oncall followups yesterday: triaged INC-2345; root cause looks like a stale quantization profile on one replica that caused slow kernels under certain seq lengths. Deployed rotation patch to affected replica group. No blocking issues now. Today: update runbook and suppression rules. Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kv-evict

alex: Good catch. @mike please annotate your PR with perf test results and include rollback instructions. Runbook currently missing forced-warm steps — please add. :thumbsup:

mike: Will annotate. Rollback done to 10% at 08:15 UTC. Observability: p99 dropped ~2% after rollback. Grafana snapshot: https://grafana.redwood/ch/d/evict (posted).

taylor: Suggestion for mitigation: reduce `batch_size` from 64 -> 48 and add `max_concurrency` clamp. I'll open a short PR (JIRA-458) with config change and smoke test.

priya: Oncall handover: I handled two follow-ups and left notes in the handover doc. Blocker: need an SLA contact for Customer X to close the ticket — who owns that account? @alex?

alex: @priya sales-eng owns Customer X (cc @sam). I'll ping Sam offline and add contact to the ticket.

priya: Thanks. Today: clean up alert noise and adjust suppression window to 5m for duplicate bursts to avoid paging on short blips.

deploy-bot: Deploy mike/kv-evict-rollback @ 08:15 UTC — success.

mike: FYI — I added extra debug logs at INFO level for the canary devices; will remove after 24h if stable. If you see log noise ping me.

linh: Small ask: can someone review my runbook PR? A few quick nits around steps for the `hotfix-quant` script. /cc @taylor @alex

taylor: I'll review this afternoon.

alex: Blockers summary: nothing blocking the release, but we need runbook updates and a couple of quick PR reviews. Plan: keep canary at 10% and monitor for 12h. Escalation: if p99 > 1.1x baseline for >15m -> rollback to 0% and page oncall.

priya: ack

mike: ack — monitoring set. Thresholds added: `p99_alert: 1.1x baseline for 15m`, `error_rate_alert: 0.5%`.

alex: Thanks team. If anything else pops up ping the oncall channel. End of thread.
